fields.description: Issue features editorials and local commentary on alleged political interference and patient care at Jackson Memorial hospital; predictions of a strong winter tourist season for Miami; criticism of Coral Gables city commission actions affecting the transportation department and other municipal offices; discussion of Hialeah civic finances and calls for administrative resignation and election; coverage of hurricane relief and skepticism about National Red Cross spending; notes on Lake Okeechobee flood-control advocacy; report on a bombing at a Flagler Street cleaning plant amid dry-cleaning price disputes; and recurring nightlife/bootlegging price listings, entertainment notices, and society items for Greater Miami.
